experience.lesson: A prior C02 model attempt made 10 source reads, no patch and no test attempt; the host stopped repeated actions without progress. Use the supplied focus and current hashes to make a bounded edit before requesting further unchanged source.

instruction: Fix validate() split-file reads. The loop currently reads until EOF and checks declared row count only afterward. Bound total bytes consumed to the initial fstat size plus at most one detection byte; stop on growth or extra rows before parsing another JSON row. Keep per-line bounds, descriptor identity checks, exact SHA/row validation and every duplicate, license, source URL and RU/ES task coverage rule. Valid stable corpora must retain their existing output. Change only forge_split_guard.py and use the existing immutable verifier. Do not start training or claim dataset provenance or original 4A02 acceptance. The supplied focus contains the relevant loop and counters.
